correctness.rationale: The depth-one triple is direct graded semantics. The depth-two sufficiency criterion follows from row and column successor multisets. Crucial identity H_a(k+1)-H_b(k+1)=sum_{j:T_j=k}(X_aj-X_bj) is exact, with T_j omitting both compared rows; conditional independence is therefore valid. Fixed-density local binomial lower bounds, Chernoff occupancy, and Fourier anti-concentration imply o(n^-2) collision probability for each row/column pair. Degree concentration shows depth-one noninjectivity; mixed-color rows/columns produce a two-class ordinary bisimulation. Boundaries and quantifiers explicit; 530 finite matrices and 2100 seeded matrix trials passed independent refinement checks, without conflating finite evidence with infinite proof.
